audit.scope: Full codebase audit: build, lint, types, security, architecture, robustness

issues.title: TURBOPACK=1 environment variable breaks npm run build
issues.description: Parent environment has TURBOPACK=1 set, causing Next.js 14.2.35 to attempt turbopack build which is not supported for production builds.
issues.fix: Modified build script to 'unset TURBOPACK && NODE_ENV=production next build'

issues.title: NODE_ENV=development during build causes prerender failures
issues.description: React context mismatch (production vs development mode) caused useContext errors during static page prerendering for all pages.

issues.title: TooltipProvider used in Server Component layout causes SSR context error
issues.description: Radix UI TooltipProvider (client component) was imported directly in server-side layout.tsx, causing useContext failures during prerendering.
issues.fix: Created src/components/layout/Providers.tsx client component wrapper, updated layout.tsx to use it

issues.title: Path traversal vulnerability in transcription DELETE endpoint
issues.description: audioPath from database used directly in path.resolve() + fs.unlink() without validation. Malicious audioPath containing '../' could delete arbitrary files outside the project directory.
issues.fix: Added path traversal guard: resolved path must start with project root + path.sep before deletion is allowed

issues.title: ESLint configuration broken - .eslintrc.json deleted
issues.description: .eslintrc.json was deleted (only .eslintrc.json.bak existed). eslint.config.mjs flat config exists but is not supported by Next.js 14's 'next lint' command.
issues.fix: Restored .eslintrc.json with proper extends and rules

issues.title: error:any used across 12 catch blocks violates TypeScript strict mode
issues.description: CLAUDE.md mandates no 'any' type usage. Found 12 instances of 'catch (error: any)' across providers, API routes, and manager files.
issues.fix: Changed all to 'catch (error)' with 'error instanceof Error ? error.message : ...' guards

issues.title: Multiple JSON.parse calls without try-catch can crash server
issues.description: Unguarded JSON.parse() in transcribe/route.ts, settings/route.ts, manager.ts, and transcribe GET metadata parsing.
issues.fix: Wrapped all JSON.parse calls in try-catch with appropriate error responses or fallback values

issues.title: Vocabulary import upsert uses invalid id pattern
issues.description: In vocabulary import route, upsert uses 'where: { id: `${domain}-${term}` }' but ids are auto-generated CUIDs. Always fails to find existing records.
issues.fix: Replaced invalid upsert with findFirst by term+domain, then update or create accordingly

issues.title: Test-provider endpoint excludes whisper-local from validation schema
issues.description: The test-provider route's Zod schema only accepts 'openai-whisper', 'deepgram', 'vatis-tech' — excluding 'whisper-local'.
issues.fix: Added 'whisper-local' to the provider enum in testProviderSchema

issues.title: Empty interface extends lint errors block build
issues.description: InputProps and TextareaProps interfaces declared as empty extensions of React HTML attribute types, triggering @typescript-eslint/no-empty-object-type ERROR.
issues.fix: Changed from 'interface extends' to 'type =' alias pattern

issues.title: Unused import: LiveTranscriptionEvents in deepgram.ts
issues.description: LiveTranscriptionEvents imported from @deepgram/sdk but never used.

issues.title: Auth password hash stored without encrypted flag
issues.description: In auth.ts setPassword(), the Setting record was created without 'encrypted: true', meaning the encrypted hash was not flagged as sensitive data.
issues.fix: Added 'encrypted: true' to both create and update operations

issues.title: Remaining lint warnings (non-blocking)
issues.description: Fixed 32 of 35 warnings across 18 files. 3 remaining are _request params required by Next.js route handler signatures.

issues.title: ai-router local file dependency may break on fresh installs
issues.description: package.json has 'ai-router: file:../AIRouter' which depends on a sibling directory existing.
issues.note: Requires architectural decision on how to distribute ai-router dependency.

issues.title: No unique constraint on CustomVocabulary (term, domain)
issues.description: Database allows duplicate term+domain entries in CustomVocabulary table. Application-level dedup exists but is not enforced at DB level.
issues.note: Recommended for future: add @@unique([term, domain]) to schema.

issues.title: /api/auth/status rendered as static page
issues.description: Route accesses Prisma during static generation, causing DATABASE_URL validation errors.
issues.fix: Added export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic' to force server-side rendering

issues.title: ESLint no-unused-vars not ignoring underscore-prefixed args
issues.description: 3 warnings for _request params in providers and stream routes.

issues.title: Unguarded JSON.parse in templates routes (4 locations)
issues.description: Template structure stored as JSON string in DB. JSON.parse(template.structure) called without try-catch in GET list, GET detail, POST response, and PUT response. Corrupted structure data crashes the route.
issues.fix: Wrapped all 4 JSON.parse calls in try-catch with fallback to { sections: [] }

issues.title: Unguarded JSON.parse in whisper-server getSavedModel()
issues.description: getSavedModel() calls JSON.parse on saved setting value. If the value is corrupted, the entire whisper-server GET/POST handler crashes.
issues.fix: Wrapped in try-catch with 'small' fallback default

issues.title: Report DELETE leaves orphan transcription.reportId references
issues.description: Deleting a report does not null out reportId on linked transcriptions. This leaves dangling foreign key references which can cause errors when querying transcriptions with report includes.
issues.fix: Added prisma.transcription.updateMany to set reportId=null before report deletion

issues.title: Whisper-server start accepts unvalidated model name for spawn
issues.description: The 'start' action accepts body.model and passes it to child_process.spawn as CLI argument without validating against known models. Combined with the vocabulary bulk POST not deduplicating.
issues.fix: Added model validation against MODELS list before spawn; added duplicate check to vocabulary bulk POST

build.details: Compiled successfully. All 19 static pages generated. All API routes compiled. 0 errors.

architecture_review.provider_abstraction: GOOD - Clean abstract class pattern with 4 concrete implementations
architecture_review.singleton_pattern: GOOD - STTManager, AudioManager, AuthManager properly singleton
architecture_review.encryption: GOOD - AES-256-GCM with PBKDF2 key derivation
architecture_review.authentication: ADEQUATE - Cookie-based session with encrypted tokens
architecture_review.input_validation: GOOD - All JSON.parse calls guarded, path traversal blocked, model names validated, duplicates handled

recommendations: Add @@unique([term, domain]) constraint to CustomVocabulary in Prisma schema
Publish ai-router as npm package or monorepo workspace to eliminate local file dependency
Add automated tests (unit + integration) - currently 0 test files exist
Consider upgrading to Next.js 15 for native turbopack build support
